reviewed_decisions.topic: Type 3 glyphs execute as content streams in pdf-model
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: Consistent with §9.6.4's defining rule that glyphs are streams of PDF graphics operators. Current Type3Font and nested interpreter path were inspected. No reconsideration indicated by this review.
reviewed_decisions.residual: This does not certify all PDF operator categories or every nested-content boundary.

reviewed_decisions.topic: d1 glyph paints use inherited fill/stroke color parameters
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: The current source's example and Table 111 singular color sentence, §9.3.3, and §8.6.8 were inspected alongside current d0/d1 and stroke tests. Existing assertions discriminate red/blue or alpha and include d0 control. No new conflict found.
reviewed_decisions.residual: d1 transparency/color operator handling is a scoped reading of referenced clauses; no broad certification of all §8.6.8 operators here.

reviewed_decisions.topic: Refuse Type 3 FontMatrix with no inverse
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: Table 110 requires FontMatrix mapping glyph space to text space; §9.2.4 describes that map. Current read refuses no-inverse matrices, and a test asserts the refusal. No contrary evidence found.
reviewed_decisions.residual: The normative characterization of singular affine maps is the ADR's interpretation; this review did not seek new owner adjudication.

reviewed_decisions.topic: Type 3 resource fallback resolves to page resources per EC3 #128
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: EC3's amended §7.8.3 sequence and a current nested-form test support glyph-stream/font/page resolution; current glyph-stream collision test independently asserts precedence. No reversal indicated.
reviewed_decisions.residual: Inherited page-resource details beyond the targeted test were not exhaustively enumerated.

reviewed_decisions.topic: Refuse Type 3 recursive glyph at re-entry
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: EC3 #111 says implementations need avoid recursion and result is implementation-dependent. Existing hostile-budget tests show bounded refusal and a nonrecursive control. The ADR's refusal is allowed, not required.
reviewed_decisions.residual: Do not characterize recursion refusal as the only standard-conforming outcome.

reviewed_decisions.topic: OpenType wrapper selection by embedded CFF/glyf and font dictionary type
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: The §9.9.1 bullet distinction is reflected in the changed `type1_cff_in_opentype` path and selected OpenType audit tests. This bounded review did not independently recompute all CFF charset/cmap outcomes; decision retained provisionally.
reviewed_decisions.residual: Partial selected-row verification; no statement about every OpenType table requirement.

reviewed_decisions.topic: Use a substitute face for an embedded but unreadable font program
reviewed_decisions.decision_check: §9.5 and §9.8.1 permit a substitute when the program is unavailable; they do not mandate this policy. The changed loader path explicitly keeps/report the refusal while substituting. This pass did not validate substitute appearance, all refusal types, or new public behavior.
reviewed_decisions.residual: Policy is permissive and product/owner-directed; partial review only.

focused_test_decision.finding: The baseline adds save/restore of shape_only_glyph in content/text/type3.rs, but inspected Type3 tests establish only that d1 ignores transparency changes inside the glyph. No test asserts a normal page ExtGState after d1 glyph invocation takes effect.
focused_test_decision.action: Draft a viewer integration regression with a blue page state, a d1 glyph invoking /Half gs, then page content that switches to black, invokes /Half gs, and paints. Expected glyph paint is blue/alpha 1; following page fill is black/alpha 0.5. This tests internal d1 suppression and restoration without relying on malformed input.
focused_test_decision.authority: §9.6.4 step c: graphics state is restored after glyph; Table 111 d1 color-related operators are ignored and processing continues.
focused_test_decision.interpretation: Test gap only; current code appears to implement the expected behavior. No reported current failure because parent is running the baseline suite.
